pick.name: Docling (IBM Research / LF AI & Data)
pick.what: PDF/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX/HTML/images/audio to Markdown/JSON with layout, tables, OCR
pick.why: Highest-fidelity open parser, runs on Windows (x86_64/arm64), MIT code, vendor-neutral foundation

alts.name: MarkItDown (Microsoft)
alts.why: Quick and tiny when fidelity is not critical

alts.name: Unstructured (OSS)
alts.what: Partitioning library for many doc types, paid hosted API

candidates.name: Docling
candidates.verdict: Pick: best fidelity free, CPU ok

candidates.name: MarkItDown
candidates.verdict: Alt: lightweight; OCR needs an LLM client

candidates.name: Claude API native PDF/vision input
candidates.verdict: Often simplest for few documents; paid per token (not source-verified here)

candidates.name: Gemini PDF understanding
candidates.verdict: Cheap, but free tier trains on data

decision: Docling for local ingestion of clinical/legal PDFs. Use MarkItDown for quick Office-to-text, and send hard scanned pages to Claude vision.
details: Docling CPU speed on target hardware not measured.
